name: Raven Movie Editor
summary: Opens a RavenRS film (.ravenmovie) or a bug report (.ravenbug) and edits it on a timeline: cuts, boxes, narration and chapters. The films come from the Raven Test Studio, the trainings and the bug reports of the apps.
when_to_use: To look at the film of a test that failed in the Raven Test Studio.
To edit a training film or the film of a bug report before sharing it.

commands.does: Opens the film, or asks for one; a bug report prints what it says in the terminal. Saving keeps the film beside it. Closing the window keeps it beside the clock.
Opens the editor on a made-up film with no window; exit code 0 when it draws.

limits: It edits RavenRS films, not video files: Raven Channel Video writes those.
